title: Pip Waits Out the Storm
note: b415 — Phase 5 (School readiness) — new sounds 'wh' and 'ph'.

pages.brief: Pip the sparrow looking up, startled, at a darkening sky.
Rain starting to fall hard across the garden in strong wind.
Pip the sparrow flying quickly to find shelter.
Pip the sparrow noticing a dry gap in the side of the compost heap.
Pip the sparrow burrowing into the dry gap in the compost heap.
Pip the sparrow tucked into a soft, dry gap inside the compost heap.
Pip the sparrow peeking out at the rain still falling outside.
Pip the sparrow watching the dark rainy sky from his dry gap.
The rain easing and the wind dying down over the garden.
Pip the sparrow hopping out into bright sunshine after the storm.
